task.description:
Update documentation after EE-05 (Exclusive Gateway) release.

1. Set `EE-05` status to `RELEASED` in `docs/status/requirement_status.json`:
   - `released_at`: current ISO8601 timestamp
   - `release_run`: `"WF02-ee05-20260522"`
   - `implemented_in`: `["src/engine/transition.zig", "vendor/cel/cel.zig"]`
   - `test_spec`: `"tests/specs/EE-05.md"`
   - `test_run`: `"WF02-ee05-20260522-run-01.md"`
   - `tested_at`: current date (YYYY-MM-DD)

2. Add a CHANGELOG entry under the current version heading:
   ```
   ### EE-05 — Exclusive gateway (RELEASED)
   - Implemented CEL expression evaluator in `vendor/cel/cel.zig` (recursive descent parser; subset: bool/int/string literals, `variables.<key>` access, comparison and boolean operators, parentheses)
   - Updated `src/engine/transition.zig` EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY handler to evaluate edge conditions via `cel.evaluate`; CEL runtime errors treated as `false` per EE-05 AC
   - Added TC-EE-05-01 through TC-EE-05-17 unit tests; all pass
   ```

3. Run the retrospective for run `WF02-ee05-20260522` per `docs/agents/metrics.md §6`:
   - Read `handoffs/WF02-ee05-20260522/estimation.json`
   - Compute actual time per step from `started_at`/`completed_at` in each step handoff
   - Write retrospective to `docs/metrics/retrospectives/WF02-ee05-20260522.json`
   - Add retrospective file to `artifacts_out`
acceptance_criteria: EE-05 status set to RELEASED in requirement_status.json
